verdict.rationale: Fly.io is a cloud and edge compute platform, so a durable-workflow capability is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no workflow-as-code engine with built-in durable steps, queues or retries. Machine restart policies, Sprite checkpoints and long-running VMs are adjacent infrastructure primitives a developer could build on, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy durable, long-running workflows as code without manually wiring queues and retries
